description: Removes another member from one of your companies; their access ends immediately. Owners can remove anyone; admins only members and viewers. You cannot remove yourself (use company_leave) and a company keeps at least one owner. Call without confirm first for a preview, then again with confirm and the preview_token.

confirm.description: Set true only on the second call, after the user approved the preview.

preview_token.description: The preview_token returned by the first call (same input).

name: company_member_remove
title: Remove a member
